description: This file contains the implementation of the MediaPipelineTestBase class, which provides a base for unit testing media pipeline components. It includes mock setup, media pipeline creation and destruction, and methods to simulate media source attachment, EOS handling, and data notification expectations.

classes.name: MediaPipelineTestBase
classes.description: A base class for unit testing media pipeline components, providing setup, teardown, and utility methods for simulating media pipeline behavior.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase::createMediaPipeline
methods.description: Creates and initializes the media pipeline object, setting up necessary mocks and expectations.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase::destroyMediaPipeline
methods.description: Destroys the media pipeline object and cleans up resources.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase::mainThreadWillEnqueueTask
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueuing a task on the main thread.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase::mainThreadWillEnqueueTaskAndWait
methods.description: Sets expectation for enqueuing a task on the main thread and waiting for its completion.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase::loadGstPlayer
methods.description: Loads a GStreamer player mock and initiates media loading.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase::attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source of specified type and MIME type to the media pipeline.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase::setEos
methods.description: Simulates end-of-stream condition for a media source.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase::expectNotifyNeedData
methods.description: Sets expectations for notifying the need for media data.

methods.name: MediaPipelineTestBase::expectNotifyNeedDataEos
methods.description: Sets expectations for notifying end-of-stream media data.
